svg.title: Architectural Design of the Developed RBIM System
svg.desc: Six colored layers show presentation clients, Laravel application modules, native PHP forecasting, supporting services, MySQL and persistent files, and configured VPS deployment. HTTPS connects clients to the application. A separate Eloquent path links the application to storage. Optional Ollama is shown with a dashed border.
svg.text: Architectural Design of the Developed System
Laravel Blade | HTML and CSS | JavaScript | Leaflet | Resident Android client through HTTPS API
Controllers and services | Sessions and Sanctum tokens | Roles, approvals and scoped record access
Last-month baseline | Moving average | Exponential smoothing | Holt trend | Verified history required
MySQL Database and Persistent File Storage
Eloquent reads and writes / protected file access
Hostinger VPS configuration | App and MySQL containers | Private networks | Optional Ollama container
Figure 1. Architectural design of the developed RBIM system.
Dashed path: supporting-service connection. Dashed box: optional component. Deployment hosts the application and data tiers.
